summary: First-iteration full-stack testing of Tiffin OS MVP. 34/34 pytest backend tests passed after fixing 2 minor Mongo _id serialization bugs. All critical frontend flows (landing, provider signup, dashboard, add customer, mark delivered, settings save, consumer signup, submit payment, provider verify, auth guards) work end-to-end via the public URL.

minor.issue: Returned inserted doc contained Mongo ObjectId `_id`, causing 500 on serialization. FIXED by popping `_id` before return.
Same ObjectId serialization 500. FIXED by popping `_id`.

issues: After a provider verifies a payment while the consumer's customer is still pending approval (no deliveries yet), outstanding displays as negative (e.g. -$25.00). This is technically correct (paid − delivered) but is confusing UX — consider clamping display to $0 or showing a 'credit' label.

action_items: Review the two backend fixes for _id stripping (routes_customers.create_customer, routes_consumer.submit_payment) — consider a shared helper or model_dump on Pydantic before return.
Optional UX: show negative outstanding (credit) more explicitly on consumer home.
critical_code_review_comments: Consumer /api/consumer/deliveries always regenerates 14 days ahead on every call — for many consumers this is 14 DB scans per request. Acceptable for MVP but should be batched or cached.
outstanding_summary in reports iterates all customers with N+1 aggregations — will be slow beyond a few hundred customers.
routes_customers.resume_customer only clears future/current pauses but keeps past ones — behaviour matches doc-string but consider dropping pauses entirely on resume for simplicity.
generate_for_date uses datetime.utcnow() (deprecated) for created_at while other modules use datetime.now(timezone.utc). Standardize.
cancel_delivery assumes 12:00 UTC delivery time regardless of provider timezone — could produce surprising cutoffs for west-coast providers. Note is called out in problem statement.
test_credentials: Fresh accounts created via signup. Sample from run: provider pw_owner_1783926608@test.com / secret123 (signup_code TF-CFC349). Consumer pw_cons_1783926658@test.com / consumer123.
seed_data_creation: No seed data; every test creates its own TEST_-prefixed provider/customer/consumer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope which fragments session-scoped fixtures across workers; run backend tests with `-n 0` OR keep interdependent tests inside a single class (loadscope keeps a class on one worker). Backend URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Firebase /api/auth/google returns 501 by design — do not treat as bug. Payment screenshot without R2 stored as base64 data URL is expected.
rca of the issue: 500 on customer create + consumer payment submit was root-caused to endpoints returning the same dict that PyMongo mutated with an ObjectId `_id` after insert_one. Fastapi's default response serializer cannot encode ObjectId, hence 500. Fix: pop `_id` before return (or return via a fresh find_one with {_id:0} projection).
